He was the Ex-Dean of the Faculty of Computers and Information, Cairo University. Currently, he is the Dean of the Artificial Intelligence College affiliated to Arab Academy for Science and Technology. Aly Fahmy received the M.Sc. and Ph.D. degrees in Artificial Intelligence from the National Superior School E.N.S.A.E in Toulouse, France in 1976 and 1979, respectively. He obtained specialized on Job Training on developing Expert Systems, IntelliCorp, Germany and on developing large scale software systems, Litton Systems Inc, U.S.A. Currently, Dr. Fahmy is currently involved in the activities led by Dr. Ismail Abdul-Gaffar Ismail the President of Arab Academy for Science and Technology to establish the Arabic Center of Excellence for Artificial Intelligence and Frontier Technologies in New El-Alamein City.
